description: Write a file to a sandbox, creating or overwriting it. Parent directories are created automatically. Set encoding to base64 to write binary content. Inline content is limited to 8 MiB; on the hosted endpoint, keep it under about 4 MiB of text or 3 MiB of binary (base64), or the request fails with HTTP 413. Upload larger files with the SDK/CLI.

content.description: File content (UTF-8 text, or base64 when encoding=base64).

path.description: Absolute path inside the sandbox, e.g. "/app/main.py".

name: sandbox_files_write
title: Write a file to a sandbox
